title: Flag Breaker
text: So this was the day Itsuki got sent off as a guest lecturer, I say. Father, Rival, and I saw him off as he grumbled a bit about the whole thing being kind of a hassle before flying off through a portal. Ren had already headed out earlier to study weapon-crafting.
“Now then, Naofumi, let’s go secretly watch over Bow Hero, nano! Oh, Spear Hero can come too, nano. We’ll watch from hiding, nano! Nano nano!”
Rival threw up a fist like she was announcing “let’s-a-go!” and made her proposal to Father. My own motivation immediately plummeted, but I decided I’d act based on however Father reacted.
“I had a feeling there was some ulterior motive here… and yep, there it is.”
“Not really an ulterior motive, nano. It’s just that, from Naofumi’s perspective, there’s definitely something interesting to see, nano!”
“Oh?” Father’s expression showed sudden interest in what Rival was saying.
“Specifically?”

“According to Wild Naofumi, there’s a classic development pattern waiting to happen, one you’d associate with Bow Hero, nano. Wild Naofumi said, ‘That kind of development is exactly suited for an Itsuki who isn’t broken!’ nano.”

Gah— Rival, you traitor! Did Father really say something like that?! I can’t quite remember where, but I do recall Father saying something along those lines back in that world after peace had settled.
“Ah, so it’s ‘the ideal candidate as decided by my other self,’ huh. An Itsuki who isn’t broken… thinking about it that way, the Itsuki in this world really is a rare specimen.”

“An undistorted, un-twisted Bow Hero is indeed rare, nano. That’s exactly why we should gift Bow Hero with a delicious development, nano! I bet deep down he’ll be thrilled, nano! It’s a protagonist development, nano!”
“Different from an awakening, I take it?”
“Different, nano.”
“Well… I’m not sure how reliable Gaelion-chan’s instincts are on this, but I’m a little worried, so let’s go keep an eye on things.”
“That’s right, nano! Naofumi, order Spear Hero and let’s depart, nano! Also, Rishia, you need to start preparing for school starting tomorrow or so, nano!”
Rival said this to Riska and Rafuemon, who’d been waving goodbye as Itsuki departed.
“Fweeeh… why?! Itsuki-sama said I didn’t need to come!”
“That’s right, Gaelion-san. Itsuki-kun said we didn’t need to go, so we all agreed we’d just watch over him warmly from a distance, didn’t we?”
“Is that really something you should be saying, nano? Rishia, a fun campus life awaits with Bow Hero, nano.”
“Campus life…”
“Ah, Rishia-san, sounds like you’ve got a bit of longing there.”

Well, apparently Riska had been rather plain and unremarkable even back at her academy, I say. Her school life probably wasn’t exactly blessed. If we focused our search around the library after school, I’d bet we’d run into her old self there without fail, I say.
“Even against sinister, malicious bullying, with the strength you’ve gained through relentless training, you could easily turn the tables on them, nano.”

Incidentally, after Riska recovered mentally back in the village, she’d also diligently trained in the way of ki, so her latent abilities had already blossomed, I say. To the point where, if she ever decided to fight, her body would move on its own with quite impressive form. She’d originally had a strong presence against bullying anyway—strong enough that I’d once mistaken her for a stalker—so surely by now she could give as good as she got. Above all, she now carried the prestige of being one of Itsuki’s companions, so the moment any bullying reached Itsuki’s eyes, the perpetrators would be in for a world of pain, I say. Absolutely, deliciously deserved, I say! Sneaky wrongdoing? Please. Itsuki himself is more than capable of secret surveillance, I say.
“Fleon-chan will also be deployed later, I say! I will not permit any sinister, malicious bullying, I say!”
“For some reason, in this flow of conversation, even Motoyasu-kun is getting fired up.”
“My school days are filled with countless black histories, but striking down anyone who tries to bully Riska is surely a good deed, I say!”

Pigs are creatures that engage in sinister, malicious bullying, I say! Gathering evidence and meting out punishment is surely an act of justice befitting Fleon-chan and her allies, I say! Fufufu… I simply cannot wait for the moment when the pigs infesting that academy get exterminated by Itsuki and Fleon-chan’s group. And while we’re at it, Father and I shall forge a friendship at the academy. The ending is inevitable, I say.
“Once the pigs are exterminated, I shall take over as lecturer, I say.”

“Somehow… I get the feeling that inside Motoyasu-kun’s brain, the academy has become a place with the female student population completely wiped out. An academy with only men in it feels like it wouldn’t have a single flower in bloom…”
Fleon-chan had gone out for a walk with Filoko-chan. Once she got back, we’d invite her along to Itsuki’s academy, I say.
“I-Itsuki-kun…”
“Fweeeeeh…”
“Well, with that settled, let’s begin our secret surveillance, nano!”
And so, Rival, Father, and I secretly went to observe Itsuki’s first day taking up his post at the academy, I say.

Having promptly flown to a nearby location via portal, Itsuki then boarded a repurposed version of the airplane Takt had built, being guided toward the academy’s location, I say. I switched to Drive Mode, while Father rode on Rival’s back, and together we flew through the sky, keeping watch on Itsuki’s plane from a distance, I say. The unfortunate part was that Father chose to ride on Rival’s back. Even after I switched to Change Drive Mode, he still wouldn’t ride with me. Surely the cause was that my Flying Mode couldn’t quite keep up with the speed of Itsuki’s plane. I really must design a high-speed movement form sometime soon, I say. Naturally equipped with Cloaking Lance and stealth mode, of course, I say. Eventually the plane touched down on a flat stretch of land near the academy. From there, a several-decades-long carriage ride—no wait, several tens of minutes—brought us to the grounds of the magic academy in question.
“Well, well, Bow Hero-sama… we are truly grateful you’ve taken the trouble to come all this way to our academy this time. Forgive my lack of introduction—I am the head of this academy.”
“I’m Itsuki Kawasumi, summoned as Bow Hero. I accepted this invitation… though I merely fought against the Waves; I haven’t accomplished nearly as much as the other Heroes.”
“Bow Hero-sama, you are remarkably humble. I do wish our own students here could learn from your example.”
“So… I take it we’ll be starting the lesson right away? Honestly, I’m not sure what exactly I’m qualified to teach—if anything, I’d like someone to teach me instead…”
“There’s no need to feel so much pressure. Simply conversing with our faculty or demonstrating some magic for the students would already be a wonderful learning experience for them.”
“I see…”
Itsuki chatted along smoothly enough with this so-called headmaster, I say.

“Classes are scheduled to begin after lunch. Bow Hero-sama must be tired from the journey today. Allow me to show you to the room the academy has prepared for you at once. This here is our dormitory head—”

Hmm… so this is the magic academy, I say. I actually have some memory of this place from back in the game days, I say. Since the buildings retained the exact same layout, I could more or less recognize how everything connected. Back when it was just a game, there were countless rooms whose actual purpose I never really understood—places you’d only visit occasionally for quests—but in reality, they probably all served various functions.
“Wow… a magic academy, huh… it feels strange, like stepping into a movie. I wonder if they still do things like class assignments and dorm assignments when you enroll.”
While cloaked and keeping our voices from leaking out, Father muttered this while gazing over the buildings. He’d had that same look on his face back at the Melromarc castle too, I recall.
“Did you want to become a student, Father?”
“If you asked, Naofumi would surely get an immediate yes, nano.”

“If I wanted to learn magic, I could just have Motoyasu-kun or Gaelion-chan teach me anyway… If all I wanted was to soak in the school atmosphere, I could just walk the academy grounds as a guest lecturer like this. It’s just that, somehow, school gives off this nostalgic feeling, that’s all.”
Hmm… I see. I too felt, back when I attended school, as though that place was my entire world, I say. Countless floor plans of the various schools I’d attended flickered through my mind, I say.

“If there’d been some kind of development where I got summoned as a Hero and immediately started attending an academy, I think I would’ve gone along with it without complaint. Ah, you don’t need to actually go and do that in a loop, though.”
Father hastily corrected himself, sounding a bit panicked. Oh? So apparently that meant I didn’t need to act on it.
“Now that you mention it, this place somehow feels similar in atmosphere to where Rat-san’s research facility is, too…”
“They’re definitely affiliated, nano. That one’s the research institute located in the royal capital, nano.”
“Judging from what I’d heard beforehand, this academy apparently has quite a long tradition too.”

While we were chatting away like this, some pig or other was apparently being introduced to Itsuki, I say. Seemed to be the dormitory head pig in charge of managing the dorms. The headmaster left to make arrangements for the lesson schedule, I say.
“Bu-boo!”
Itsuki was being guided along by the academy’s dormitory head pig, I say.
“I do have a teleportation skill, so I don’t necessarily need to actually live in the dorm, but…”
“Boo-boo-boo-boo-boo, boo-boo-bwee.”

Seemed like the pig was explaining something to him. Itsuki, sighing, arrived in front of the room assigned to him. Then, casually, he placed his hand on the door… and for some reason performed that ear-to-the-door move that a certain military-obsessed pig used to do, before asking the pig a question.
“This room is supposed to be mine, and no one should currently be inside, correct?”
“B-boo… boo-boo-boo.”
“I see… in that case—”
He swapped the bow he was holding into a firearm—a grenade launcher—swung the door open in a hurry, and fired!
“Paralyze Smoke Shot!”
With a *bshoo*, Itsuki fired the round and simultaneously slammed the door shut. A hissing sound of smoke billowing out inside the room echoed through the hall.
“Bwe-EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!?”
The pig’s squeal rang out, and eventually fell silent.
“B-boo…?”
“I had a bad feeling about it, so it’s good I took precautions just in case.”

When the door opened and the smoke cleared, there lay a completely naked pig, looking like it had just gotten out of the shower, collapsed on the floor. Had it been in the middle of some sort of sanitizing routine?
“Boo… boo-bwee? Boo-boo-boo…”
Itsuki was carefully not looking. The dormitory head pig entered the room and draped a towel over the naked pig.
“I suppose it’s probably been an empty room for quite a while, so it was being used as a makeshift changing room or something?”
“Boo… boo-boo-boo-boo… boo-boo…”

The dormitory head pig cast a healing spell on the collapsed pig to treat the paralysis. It seemed there was no mistaking that this really was the world-renowned magic academy of pride, I say. Fitting, given this was the very academy that the magic shopkeeper who’d lent Father so much assistance had once attended. The dormitory head pig apparently also came fully equipped with healing magic, I say.
“Boo-boo, boo-boo-boo-bwee! Boo-boo-boo!”
“No… bragging about your family lineage and grades to me won’t change anything. I’m the Bow Hero of the Four Cardinal Heroes here, which puts me on a completely different level from that.”
“B-boo? Boo-boo-boo! Boo-bwee, boo-bwee!”

The pig looked utterly stunned for a moment, but instantly snapped back to its senses, pointing at Itsuki and shrieking. This rhythm… I vaguely recall this pattern, I say. Presumably, some mysterious duel challenge was being issued.
“Boo-boo-boo… bwee! Boo-boo!”
At this point, the dormitory head pig bellowed loudly at the naked pig.

“Shouldn’t you first report the matter of unauthorized use of an academy room to the appropriate representative? Also, even if you win some sort of duel, that won’t erase what you’ve done. To begin with, this could be construed as an attempt at some scheme against me, so I think it would be in your future best interest to simply leave the room now, don’t you?”

Scolded by the dormitory head pig and coldly dismissed by Itsuki, the naked pig turned even redder in the face and began shrieking further. Hearing the commotion, the headmaster came rushing over, quite literally flying in.
“What in the world do you think you’re doing?! Do you have any idea who this man is?! This is Bow Hero-sama, one of the Four Cardinal Heroes who saved the world from the Waves!”
“B-bwee-EEEEE!?”
Even the naked pig, upon being shouted at by the headmaster, finally seemed to grasp the gravity of the situation.
“I thought you were an honor student, but… I’m disappointed. As for the expulsion you’re so upset about—yes, it must be carried out. Don’t do anything that would make your parents grieve.”

“Now, now, Headmaster… I do think what she did was rather malicious, but it seems cruel to cut off her future entirely… If she simply stays away from me, I’ll let this go unquestioned, so please, show her some mercy.”
“If Bow Hero-sama says so… then you’d best be thanking Bow Hero-sama. Now hurry up and leave.”
“B-bwee-EEEE!”
With authority failing her and her voice full of frustration, the pig stormed out of the room.
“I do apologize deeply for getting you caught up in such an incident right after your arrival.”
“Please don’t worry about it. I had a feeling this might happen…”
Saying this, Itsuki walked over toward the room’s balcony… and casually swapped the bow, currently in grenade-launcher form, into a handgun—
“Bwee—”

*Bang!* He shot clean through the forehead of a pig falling from above, flicking it aside so it wouldn’t catch on the railing. The shot pig plummeted toward the ground with a *floomp*, though it apparently floated briefly just before hitting the ground before landing. Must have been equipped with some kind of wind-attribute gear.
“So that’s one classic pattern snapped in half… now, where’s the next one coming from, I wonder?”
“M-my, Bow Hero-sama, you certainly seem remarkably well-prepared.”
“Well, someone scattered hints about this so thoroughly it was impossible to miss… Anyway, I’m going to go rest in my room now.”
“Yes… please, take your time…”
Saying so, the headmaster and the dormitory head pig left the room.
